items.title: 5 stocks with consistent score improvement and upside potential of up to 24% in 1 year, according to analysts
items.description: There is no rule that says the bad news gets priced in quickly. It is, sometimes, a process that takes very long. The current phase is probably like that – a slow and long-drawn downturn. You know, of course, that it will pass, but you cannot say when. And it is the waiting that tests everyone's patience.
